templates.name: Welcome
templates.subject: Welcome to Meerko
templates.preheader: What Meerko does, and what to do first.
templates.html:
Hi {{ person.properties.name | split: ' ' | first | default: 'there' }},

Thanks for signing up. I'm Iker, and I build Meerko.

Meerko is outbound for your AI. You tell Claude, ChatGPT or any MCP client who you sell to; Meerko finds the people, finds their emails and sends the sequence from your own inbox. By default you approve every email before it goes out.

The first step is connecting the mailbox you'll send from.

Connect a mailbox

Who are you hoping to reach? Reply and tell me: I read every reply.

Iker
Founder, Meerko

templates.name: Day 1: connect your mailbox
templates.subject: Connect a mailbox to send your first sequence
templates.preheader: Two minutes with Gmail, one click with Outlook.
templates.html:
Hi {{ person.properties.name | split: ' ' | first | default: 'there' }},

Meerko sends from your own inbox, so the first step is connecting one.

Gmail or Google Workspace takes about two minutes with an app password. Outlook and Microsoft 365 is one click with Sign in with Microsoft.

Connect a mailbox

Then ask your AI something like: "Find 20 leads that fit my ICP and draft a 3-step sequence." By default you approve every email before it sends.

Iker
Founder, Meerko

templates.name: Day 3: start your first sequence (mailbox connected)
templates.subject: Your mailbox is ready. Start your first sequence
templates.preheader: One message to your AI gets it going.
templates.html:
Hi {{ person.properties.name | split: ' ' | first | default: 'there' }},

Your mailbox is connected, so you're one step from your first sequence. Ask your AI:

"Find 20 leads that fit my ICP, find their emails, and draft a 3-step sequence for them."

You'll see every email before it goes out. A new mailbox starts with a few sends a day and ramps up on its own, so it stays out of spam.

Open Meerko

Iker
Founder, Meerko

templates.name: Day 7: stuck connecting your mailbox?
templates.subject: Stuck connecting your mailbox?
templates.preheader: The usual blockers, and how to get past them.
templates.html:
Hi {{ person.properties.name | split: ' ' | first | default: 'there' }},

You haven't connected a mailbox yet, and that's where most people get stuck. The usual reasons:

- Gmail has no App passwords page: 2-Step Verification is off, or a Google Workspace admin has turned app passwords off.

- Outlook asks for an admin: your IT admin needs to approve Meerko once.

What to check, and the steps for your admin

Still stuck? Email contact@meerko.ai and I'll help you get connected. This is the last reminder.

Iker
Founder, Meerko

templates.name: Emails waiting for approval
templates.subject: Your first emails are waiting for your OK
templates.preheader: Nothing sends until you approve it.
templates.html:
Hi {{ person.properties.name | split: ' ' | first | default: 'there' }},

You started a sequence yesterday, but none of its emails have gone out yet: Meerko waits for you to approve each one first.

Read and approve them in the sequence, or ask your AI: "Show me the emails waiting for approval and approve the ones that look right."

Review the emails

Approving an email sends it when its step is due; each follow-up waits for its own approval. If you'd rather Meerko send on its own, change it in Settings, under Sending.

Iker
Founder, Meerko

templates.name: Mailbox disconnected: sending stopped
templates.subject: Sending stopped: reconnect {{ event.properties.mailbox }}
templates.preheader: Meerko can't sign in to this mailbox anymore.
templates.html:
Meerko

Your mailbox lost its connection

Meerko can no longer sign in to {{ event.properties.mailbox }}, so nothing is sending from it and its replies aren't being read. This usually means its password or app password changed, or its access was revoked.

Your other mailboxes keep sending. Reconnect this one and its emails pick up where they stopped.

Reconnect the mailbox

You get this because you own the Meerko workspace this mailbox is in.

templates.name: Credits running low
templates.subject: You have {{ event.properties.balance }} Meerko credits left
templates.preheader: Add credits before lead search and enrichment stop.
templates.html:
Meerko

Your credits are running low

Your workspace has {{ event.properties.balance }} credits left. A found email costs 5, a verification 1 and each search result 1; misses are free.

When they run out, lead search and enrichment stop until you add more. Sequences already running keep sending: sending uses no credits.

Add a credit pack, or move to Pro for credits every month.

Add credits

You get this because you own the Meerko workspace these credits belong to.
